skill.summary: Search candidates, manage jobs, view pipelines, track billing and team performance in Recruitly CRM via MCP.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Recruitly MCP skill.
- Search candidates, manage jobs, view pipelines, and track team performance via Recruitly CRM.
- Provides tools for searching candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, and pipelines.
- Includes setup instructions for OAuth token and mcporter configuration.
- Returns tenant-specific options for job and candidate statuses to support localization.
- Results respect account permissions and support pagination (limit: 50 per request).
